website.note: Lists ART27.13, ART26.12, ART12.11; details accessed via 10-K.

ctgov.note: No Artelo-sponsored studies registered under exact 'Artelo Biosciences' sponsor query; CAReS Phase 2a may be registered under a CRO or academic site.

pipeline.modality: Synthetic dual cannabinoid GPCR (CB1/CB2) receptor agonist (oral)
pipeline.license_origin: Worldwide exclusive license from NEOMED (Jan 2018); originally developed by AstraZeneca

indications.trial_design: Phase 1b dose-titration plus Phase 2a placebo-controlled assessment in cancer patients (primarily lung and gastrointestinal); top dose 1300 mcg; primary endpoints body weight, lean body mass, activity scores.
indications.trial_status: ONGOING — Phase 2a interim results announced Sep 3, 2025 (positive: +6.38% mean body weight gain at top dose vs -5.42% placebo); 32 participants enrolled to date in CAReS Phase 2.

pipeline.license_origin: Worldwide exclusive license from Stony Brook University

indications.trial_name: Phase 1 Single Ascending Dose (SAD) study of ART26.12 in healthy volunteers
indications.trial_design: First-in-human Phase 1 SAD study; 49 healthy subjects; safety, tolerability, pharmacokinetics endpoints.
indications.trial_status: Phase 1 SAD enrollment complete; favorable results announced June 2025 (no drug-related AEs, dose-linear PK). Multiple Ascending Dose / patient studies to follow.

excluded_legacy_terminated.asset: ART27.13 legacy AstraZeneca Phase 1 (5 trials, 205 subjects, 2007-2008)
excluded_legacy_terminated.reason: Historical Phase 1 program under prior sponsor; superseded by current Phase 2a CAReS development.
